description: RevenueDot's MIT fork of RevenueCat's Capacitor SDK (also for Ionic), pointed at RevenueDot, the open-source RevenueCat alternative for in-app purchases and subscriptions.
rules: Install only through npm aliases: "@revenuecat/purchases-capacitor": "npm:@revenuedot/purchases-capacitor@<version>", and the same for purchases-capacitor-ui. Capacitor derives native names from the npm package name.
Keep `import { Purchases } from "@revenuecat/purchases-capacitor"`; the alias leaves imports unchanged. Then run `npx cap sync`.
RevenueDot Cloud (https://api.revenuedot.app) is the default API host. For a self-hosted server, call `await Purchases.setProxyURL({ url: "https://revenuedot.example.com" })` before `configure`.
Pass each app's public key from the RevenueDot dashboard to `Purchases.configure`: appl_ for iOS and goog_ for Android.
